question: A snake gives birth to fully formed young, while a hen lays eggs. An animal that gives birth to live young is:
explanation: Vivus (alive) + pareo (bring forth) + -ous: bringing forth live young.

reasons.A: Correct: giving birth to live young.
reasons.B: Wrong: an animal that lays eggs.

question: A hen lays eggs that hatch outside her body. Animals that reproduce this way are called:
explanation: Ovum (egg) + pareo (bring forth) + -ous: bringing forth eggs.

reasons.A: Wrong: giving birth to live young.
reasons.C: Wrong: eating both plants and meat.
